answer: Beacon spot-checks plus heartbeats block sybil farming. Each identity locks 20 credits and must answer a random signal within 10 minutes on proof of work. VRF-drawn agents verify; misses push it off the ledge of expiring trust and slash 10 credits. N puppets cost N x 20 credits plus N pipelines to catch every ping, linear in N, none reusable. One heartbeat is free; silent puppets in the lagoon of unanswered challenges are slashed.
